subject: Post-demo: Trial plan and environment recommendation — ZenWell
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Sarah Li <sarah.li@zenwell.health>, James Ortega <james.ortega@zenwell.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Trial plan and environment recommendation — ZenWell

Hi Sarah and James,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the candid feedback and the product examples your team shared. Below is a concise recap and a proposed trial approach so we can align on scope, timeline, and owners.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference for clinical note ingestion and summarization across 3 pilot clinics; correctness and latency under real workload are top priorities.
- Hard constraints: PHI in scope (HIPAA), SOC 2 preferred, data residency in us-east-1, audit logs required for all inference requests.
- Success signal: automated extract-and-summarize accuracy >= 88% on the pilot prompt set and end-to-end P95 latency < 350ms for 512-token inputs.

Proposed trial plan (recommended path)
1) Week 0–1 (baseline): Hosted sandbox (Redwood hosted API) with a private workspace and dataset partitioning. Fastest to start (2 business days). Allows initial verification of accuracy and integration.
2) Week 2–3 (scale verification): Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity) for throughput and stability tests against parallel clinic traffic. Expected provisioning lead time ~2–3 weeks if agreed.
3) Optional Week 4+ (production fidelity): VPC/private deployment if you require customer-managed networking or an on-prem connector for PHI. Estimated lead 3–6 weeks depending on network approvals.

Proposed success criteria (we'll codify these into a short eval suite):
- Accuracy: F1/ROUGE-based metric with threshold >= 88% on curated prompt set (owner: ZenWell data lead)
- Latency: P95 < 350ms for 512-token requests during 90th-percentile concurrency (owner: Redwood infra)
- Stability: No more than 0.5% error rate over 24-hour stress run (owner: Redwood SRE)
- Security: Answers to your security questionnaire + proof of encryption both in transit and at rest (owner: Redwood security)

Attachments: zenwell-trial-success-criteria.xlsx, trial-environment-cost-estimate.pdf

Next steps / asks
- Sarah: confirm you are comfortable starting with Hosted sandbox as the baseline and whether we should expedite a Dedicated sandbox in parallel.
- James: confirm the contact for your procurement/network team and any mandatory vendor paperwork (PO template or procurement portal link).
- Redwood (Ben / Marissa / Soojin): we will circulate a kickoff calendar invite and a short eval checklist once Sarah confirms.

I can be available for a 30-minute kickoff next Monday or Tuesday; propose Monday 11/8 10:00–10:30 PT if that works. If you prefer, we'll slot in Ben and Marissa for a short technical deep-dive.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 10:15 AM PDT Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the candid feedback ...

Quick technical clarifications from our side to make the Hosted baseline effective:
- Model/throughput: what token-size distribution should we expect for the full clinic load? (median / 90th percentile token lengths helps size the test)
- KV cache persistence: for the summarization flow, do you need persistent per-patient KV caches between sessions? If yes, that nudges us toward Dedicated or VPC sooner.
- Network: for VPC, do you have an existing VPN/Direct Connect approval path? Most customers need 3–6 weeks for firewall/ACL approvals.

Rough environment-setup timelines (estimate):
- Hosted sandbox (private workspace): ~2 business days to provision and hand over API keys + sample eval harness.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): ~10–15 business days for capacity allocation and environment hardening if procurement is signed.
- VPC / private deployment: ~3–6 weeks depending on network tickets and customer IT sign-off.

I'm attaching an environment setup checklist that lists required network and auth artifacts so your procurement/network team can review.

Attachment: env-setup-checklist.md

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Trial plan and environment recommendation — ZenWell

Soojin, Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from our side after an internal sync: 

1) Hosted baseline: we are comfortable starting on Hosted for the initial accuracy tests, provided the workspace is isolated and encryption at rest is guaranteed.
2) Compliance: HIPAA controls are mandatory for the pilot. Please confirm Redwood's SOC 2 + BAAs and whether we can get a copy of the latest audit report.
3) Data residency: must be in us-east-1 for the pilot. Can you confirm the hosted sandbox will be pinned to that region?
4) Auditability: we need request-level audit logs for every inference call.

We attached our security questionnaire and vendor onboarding packet — our procurement lead will need those items returned during the first week. Procurement is targeting a quick vendor review; if you can provide the security responses and BAA we can accelerate.

Attachment: zenwell-security-questionnaire.pdf

We are targeting an engineering kickoff next Monday (11/8). If you can send a calendar invite with a short agenda (integration touchpoints, data flow, success criteria), that would be great.

— Sarah
Dr. Sarah Li
VP of Clinical Informatics | ZenWell Health
